verdict.rationale: Autofilling TOTP codes and passkeys through a browser extension is a fair axis for an authenticator product. The evidence pack documents only a mobile app with code sync, QR transfer, editing and a privacy screen. Nothing shows a browser extension, autofill, or passkey handling.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
